description: Data payload shape of '<domain>.plan' commands, i.e. the 'data' member of the envelope (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 2.2/2.4). Cross-file $ref is not allowed in this contract, so '$defs.plan_action' below is a verbatim inline copy of plan-action.schema.json; tests/test_engine_contract.py enforces that the copy stays equal. See contract/README.md.

domain.description: Domain that produced this plan, e.g. 'mcp' or 'skills'.

actions.description: Ordered list of write actions the plan would perform; 'apply' executes exactly this list.

summary.description: Action counts by risk level. All five keys are always present so clients can render without key-existence checks.

plan_action.description: Engine Contract v1 plan action entry (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 2.4). One entry per write action a '<domain>.plan' command would perform; 'apply' executes exactly the listed actions. Fields whose value may be absent are required but nullable so the shape is uniform across ops: digest pair and backup_path exist only for file-touching ops, cmd only for 'run-cmd', target only for path-touching ops, note only when the engine has extra context.

element.description: Element id this action belongs to, e.g. 'mcp:grok-search'.

target.description: Path the action touches, e.g. '~/.claude.json', or null for pure 'run-cmd' actions.

risk.description: Risk level (proposal section 2.4): read = pure probe, write-local = home-dir config write (backupable), exec-local = local command (build, link), network = fetch/download (forbidden in offline mode), install-remove = software install/uninstall (highest confirmation level).

before_digest.description: sha256 digest of the current target content ('sha256:...'), or null when the target does not exist or the op has no file target.

after_digest.description: sha256 digest of the content the plan would write, or null when the op removes or does not touch file content.

backup_path.description: Snapshot path the current content is backed up to before the write, or null when nothing is overwritten.

cmd.description: Command line for 'run-cmd' ops, or null otherwise.

note.description: Human-readable context, e.g. how many env placeholders resolved, or null.
